svg.title: Benchmark Results
svg.desc: Seven-model comparison transcribed from the supplied image, including parameter counts, Average and 30 benchmark rows. Spark-X2.6-1.7B is highlighted; the final 4B column is a reference. Evaluation notes appear below the table.
svg.text: * denotes reported results from publicly-released model cards / papers and - denotes scores not yet available. Spark-X2.6-4B is included as a reference.
All evaluations are conducted in thinking mode. Spark-X2.6-1.7B and Spark-X2.6-4B are evaluated with the thinking level set to high. The recommended sampling parameters for both
models are temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, and top_k=-1.
Gaokao 2026 consists of the five 2026 Chinese GAOKAO examinations (National I, National II, Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin), each graded out of 150 points. Dataset:
SWebBench: An in-house benchmark for web browsing, information retrieval, and research. It will be open-sourced soon.
PAgentBench (Personal Assistant Benchmark): An in-house benchmark for personal task management, file operations, and system interactions. It will be open-sourced soon.
